Description: "Fix Customers count card on the dashboard to show the actual number of registered customers from customerDb instead of falling back to the number of recent orders."
Instruction: "Change the val prop of the Customers card to display the length of the customerDb keys."
ReplacementContent: "                              <DashboardCard title=\"Customers\" val={`${Object.keys(customerDb || {}).length}`} icon={<Users size={18} className=\"text-[#18ba60]\"/>} isDark={isDark} />"
TargetContent: "                              <DashboardCard title=\"Customers\" val={`${stats.customerCount || recentOrders.length}`} icon={<Users size={18} className=\"text-[#18ba60]\"/>} isDark={isDark} />"
